info.title: multiagent-setup
info.description: Scaffold a multi-agent AI workspace (Claude, Nessy, Gemini, Codex, Qwen, Aider, Cline, Roo Code, Continue, Cursor, Windsurf, Copilot)

commands.name: add-provider
commands.description:
Add a provider to an existing workspace
<name>: nessy, codex, qwen, cursor, windsurf, copilot, gemini, cline, aider, continue, roo, all
--force                           Overwrite existing provider config

commands.name: hook
commands.description:
Run a hook (cross-platform)
block-dangerous | enforce-commit-msg | auto-lint | log-agent | stop-guard

commands.name: install-mcps
commands.description:
Install age-mcp and o-brien MCP servers
--docker                          Use local Docker (default, interactive)
--manual                          Enter connection strings manually
--age-conn <str>                  AGE connection string
--obrien-conn <str>               O'Brien connection string
--target <dir>                    Target dir for age-mcp clone

commands.name: new
commands.description:
Create a new multi-agent workspace
--provider <name>                 Provider: claude (default), or:
claude, nessy, codex, qwen, cursor, windsurf, copilot, gemini, cline, aider, continue, roo, all

commands.name: sync-roles
commands.description:
Sync agent roles to ~/.claude/commands/
--agency-dir <path>               Override agency-agents directory

commands.name: update
commands.description:
Update workspace templates to latest version
--force                           Overwrite all files (CLAUDE.md preserved by default)
